title: •Alert My Star Destroyer!
caption: •Alert My Star Destroyer! (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. During your deploy phase, you may reveal a capital starship from hand to ▲ its matching pilot character (or vice versa) and deploy both simultaneously. {alter}
lore: For important Imperial dignitaries, an individual Star Destroyer is placed at their personal disposal.

notes: Slip prints • (unique) although the printed Special Edition card is non-unique (wiki 'Unrestricted', no dot on the scan) — title/caption carry the slip's dot. Printed base is an IMMEDIATE EFFECT; slip banner reads EFFECT (no grabber icon). Slip prints the ▲ triangle where the stub expands 'take into hand from Reserve Deck; reshuffle'; red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Lore corrected from scan: 'placed at their personal disposal' (wiki drops 'personal'; confirmed on the 745 px V8 remake). Base scan only at 350 px; Special Edition copyright line '© LUCASFILM LTD. & TM. TM, ® & © 1998 DECIPHER INC.' legible (mirrored) on the scan. Modern: V8-D-alertmystardestroyer.gif (745 px); VB2 -pre (350) also exists, not downloaded.
